learned.text: Master Brain platform root is C:\master-brain (port 127.0.0.1:4545). Kit zips stay in C:\project1\master. Default project id is project1-commerce-intelligence. QMS (saqrandrakan) is dormant. Never print MB_PASSWORD or MB_OPS_TOKEN. Never overwrite an existing CLAUDE.md.

Arabic in Windows Terminal/conhost/Cursor looks reversed because they paint logical order LTR. Working setup: Git mintty -o Bidi=2 (not default 1 — default disables bidi on Claude Code's alternate screen) + winpty + font Courier New or Simplified Arabic Fixed (Cascadia/Consolas draw boxes). Proven launcher: C:\Belt\scripts\claude-ar.ps1; ArabBank copy: C:\ArabBank\files\arabic-terminal\Open-ArabicClaude.ps1.
